Let <MATH_0001> be a locally Noetherian scheme. Let <MATH_0002>
be a <MATH_0003>-morphism of categories fibred in groupoids over <MATH_0004>.
Assume
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> <MATH_0005> is representable by algebraic spaces,
<STRUCT_0003> <MATH_0006> satisfies (<REF_0001>),
<STRUCT_0004> <MATH_0007> is limit preserving on objects, and
<STRUCT_0005> <MATH_0008> is limit preserving.
<STRUCT_0006>
Then <MATH_0009> is smooth.

The key ingredient of the proof is More on Morphisms, Lemma
<REF_0001>
which (almost) says that a morphism of schemes of finite type over <MATH_0001>
satisfying (<REF_0002>) is a smooth morphism. The other
arguments of the proof are essentially bookkeeping.

<STRUCT_0001><STRUCT_0002>
Let <MATH_0002> be a scheme over <MATH_0003> and let <MATH_0004> be an object of <MATH_0005> over
<MATH_0006>. Let <MATH_0007> be an algebraic space representing the <MATH_0008>-fibre product
<MATH_0009>.
We have to show that the projection morphism <MATH_0010> is smooth, see
Algebraic Stacks, Definition
<REF_0003>.
In fact, it suffices to do this when <MATH_0011> is an affine scheme
locally of finite presentation over <MATH_0012>, see
Criteria for Representability, Lemma
<REF_0004>.
Then <MATH_0013> is limit preserving by
Lemma <REF_0005>.
Hence <MATH_0014> is locally of finite presentation by
Lemmas <REF_0006> and
<REF_0007>.
Choose a scheme <MATH_0015> and a surjective <ACCENT_0001>tale morphism <MATH_0016>.
Then <MATH_0017> is locally of finite presentation over <MATH_0018>.

<STRUCT_0003><STRUCT_0004>
Since <MATH_0019> satisfies (<REF_0008>) we see that so does
<MATH_0020>, see Lemma <REF_0009>.
Next, we see that <MATH_0021> satisfies
(<REF_0010>) by Lemma <REF_0011>.
Thus the composition
<MATH_0022>
satisfies (<REF_0012>) by Lemma <REF_0013>.
More on Morphisms, Lemma
<REF_0014>
shows that the composition <MATH_0023> is smooth at every finite type
point <MATH_0024> of <MATH_0025>. Since the smooth locus is open we conclude
that <MATH_0026> is a smooth morphism of schemes by
Morphisms, Lemma <REF_0015>.
Thus we conclude that <MATH_0027> is a smooth morphism
of algebraic spaces by definition.
